title: Boundedly exchangeable graphs
summary: An infinite jointly exchangeable adjacency matrix is a mixture of graphon models, and its graph is almost surely empty or dense; classical matrix exchangeability therefore excludes sparse nonempty graphs. We study a point-process alternative, graph processes, whose vertices are identified with the atoms of a locally finite point process on a Polish latent space and whose edges are drawn conditionally independently from a symmetric connection kernel $W$.
